scope: NFL REG WR/RB/TE conditional recorded-player outcomes; manually selected forecasts, not an exhaustive board
selection: First server-calculated saved receipt per account, frozen model, player and game; subsequent saves replay the first receipt. Never select rows by outcome.
evaluation: Brier and clipped log loss for all uniquely archived receipts with exactly one matching published REG WR/RB/TE outcome; missing rows remain unresolved, never losses. Report scored and unresolved counts and source hashes. Do not pool different owners or model versions.
calibration: Keep the selected late-2024 Platt mapping frozen; preserve raw probabilities alongside it. No selection or refitting using 2025, 2026 or these future labels.
approval: Descriptive monitoring only; no automatic production, EV or betting approval. A later model change requires a new artifact and new prospective cohort.
limitations: A manually selected private cohort does not establish population-wide model performance.
SavedAt is the server submission clock; database commit time and an independent external timestamp are unavailable.
SHA-256 detects accidental changes; administrators could replace records. The application offers no edit/delete endpoint.
Source hashes and retrieval clocks are retained; original historical publication clocks and active-roster participation remain unverified.
No game winner, spread, total, alternate receiving line, uncertainty interval or betting edge is supported.
